name: fieldwork
description: A practical outdoor identity inspired by contour maps and trail journals. Rugged olive, rust, and a horizon mark connect useful gear to the places it goes.
heading: work-sans
voice: Resourceful, observant, and down to earth.
rules: Use contour lines as full-bleed backgrounds at low visual density.
Keep the horizon mark horizontal even on angled applications.
Give product specifications mono typography and clearly separated rows.

system.concept: Layered survey maps, trail-equipment details, and small expedition labels. A rich landscape carries the warmth of worn canvas and useful things.
headline: There is more
out there.
features: Honest equipment for the places a screen cannot take you.
Field notes that make familiar landscapes feel new again.
A focused collection of objects with a job to do.
system.layoutNote: Dark canvas split hero, topo landscape, rust annotation chips, and numbered, mono-captioned equipment cards. A utility rhythm rather than decorative wellness softness.
